segments.text: Greetings and welcome to the MOC Introduction to Biarisk Management.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎学习慕课《生物风险管理导论》。

segments.text: In this lecture, we will focus on Personal Protective Equipment, or PPEs.
segments.zh: 在这一讲中，我们将重点讨论个人防护装备，也就是PPE。

segments.text: This is an example of PPEs as they are deployed in the field.
segments.zh: 这是个人防护装备在现场使用的一个例子。

segments.text: These field workers are equipped with PPEs, which offer protection against different kinds
segments.zh: 这些现场工作人员配备了个人防护装备，可以防护不同种类的

segments.text: of biological agents.
segments.zh: 生物因子。

segments.text: This laboratory worker is wearing a complete set of PPEs.
segments.zh: 这位实验室工作人员穿戴着全套个人防护装备。

segments.text: He has been equipped with respiratory protection, ocular protection, cutaneous protection in
segments.zh: 他配备了呼吸防护、眼部防护，以及

segments.text: the form of his biosafety suit, as well as gloves and footwear.
segments.zh: 以生物安全防护服形式提供的皮肤防护，还有手套和鞋具。

segments.text: This worker, on the other hand, has exposed surfaces of his skin and this can constitute
segments.zh: 而这位工作人员则有皮肤表面暴露在外，这可能构成

segments.text: a potential breach of containment.
segments.zh: 一种潜在的防护失效。

segments.text: PPEs, as used by field workers, represent a last line of defense against biological agents.
segments.zh: 现场工作人员使用的个人防护装备，是抵御生物因子的最后一道防线。

segments.text: These are the learning objectives for this particular lecture.
segments.zh: 这些是本讲的学习目标。

segments.text: In this lecture, you will learn about the different types of PPEs, learn how to select
segments.zh: 在这一讲中，你们将了解不同类型的个人防护装备，学习如何

segments.text: PPEs based on risk assessment, learn about the standard operating procedures associated
segments.zh: 根据风险评估选择个人防护装备，了解与个人防护装备相关的

segments.text: with PPEs, and learn about specialized PPEs.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序，并了解专用个人防护装备。

segments.text: The learning outcomes for this lecture are as follows.
segments.zh: 本讲的学习成果如下。

segments.text: Upon completion of this module, you should demonstrate the ability to describe the various
segments.zh: 完成本模块后，你们应能够描述各种

segments.text: types of PPEs, select PPEs to mitigate the risk posed by biological agents, understand
segments.zh: 类型的个人防护装备，选择个人防护装备来降低生物因子带来的风险，理解

segments.text: how administrative controls must be used concurrently with PPEs.
segments.zh: 管理控制必须如何与个人防护装备同时使用。

segments.text: There are various types of PPEs.
segments.zh: 个人防护装备有多种类型。

segments.text: These include masks for respirators, gloves, protective suits, protective eyewear and
segments.zh: 包括口罩或呼吸器、手套、防护服、防护眼镜以及

segments.text: specialized PPEs.
segments.zh: 专用个人防护装备。

segments.text: Masks for respirators are designed to protect you against biological agents that are transmitted
segments.zh: 口罩或呼吸器的设计目的是保护你免受经

segments.text: via aerosols.
segments.zh: 气溶胶传播的生物因子的危害。

segments.text: In this case, the route of entry of the biological agent into the host is via the airway.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，生物因子进入宿主的途径是呼吸道。

segments.text: A wide range of masks are currently available and the N95 respirator is one of the most
segments.zh: 目前有各种各样的口罩，N95呼吸器是当前情况下

segments.text: widely used masks in the current situation.
segments.zh: 使用最广泛的口罩之一。

segments.text: Another aspect which must be explained and explored is the fit testing of masks.
segments.zh: 另一个必须解释和探讨的方面是口罩的适合性检验。

segments.text: Reuse of masks is not recommended as masks can be compromised when they are sterilized
segments.zh: 不建议重复使用口罩，因为用消毒剂对口罩进行灭菌时，

segments.text: using disinfectants.
segments.zh: 口罩的防护性能可能会受损。

segments.text: There are standards for masks and you may refer to this particular standard from the
segments.zh: 口罩有相应的标准，你们可以参考

segments.text: European Committee for Standardization in order to obtain an insight into the standards
segments.zh: 欧洲标准化委员会的这项标准，以了解

segments.text: for masks.
segments.zh: 口罩的标准。

segments.text: The N95 respirator is available in different models, the 8210, the 1860 and 1870+.
This is an example of the 1860S which protects you against particulates and can also be
segments.zh: 这是1860S的一个例子，它可以防护颗粒物，也可以

segments.text: used as a surgical mask.
segments.zh: 用作外科口罩。

segments.text: The 3M model 8210 is designed to protect the wearer from exposure to airborne particles
segments.zh: 3M 8210型的设计目的是保护佩戴者免于接触空气中的颗粒，

segments.text: which include dust, mist, fumes, fibers and bio-aerosols such as viruses and bacteria.
segments.zh: 包括粉尘、雾、烟、纤维以及病毒和细菌等生物气溶胶。

segments.text: Please take note that this particular respirator can also be used to protect the user against
segments.zh: 请注意，这种呼吸器也可以用来保护使用者免受

segments.text: non-biological agents such as dust and other particles which are airborne.
segments.zh: 非生物因子的危害，比如粉尘和空气中的其他颗粒。

segments.text: N95s are designed to fit tightly on the face and create a seal between the user's face
segments.zh: N95的设计是紧贴面部，在使用者的面部

segments.text: and the respirator.
segments.zh: 和呼吸器之间形成密封。

segments.text: They meet certain requirements of the NIOSH 42 CFR 84 and N95 respirator will filter out
segments.zh: 它们符合NIOSH 42 CFR 84的某些要求，N95呼吸器能过滤掉

segments.text: a minimum of 95% of the solids and liquid aerosols that do not contain oil.
segments.zh: 至少95%的不含油的固体和液体气溶胶。

segments.text: One should take into account the fact that the N95 respirator has not been designed to
segments.zh: 需要考虑到的是，N95呼吸器并不是为

segments.text: protect the laboratory worker against aerosols that are borne on an oil or oil particulate.
segments.zh: 保护实验室工作人员免受附着在油或油性颗粒上的气溶胶而设计的。

segments.text: The N95 8210 cannot be used as a surgical mask and it is not resistant to fluids.
segments.zh: N95 8210不能用作外科口罩，也不防液体。

segments.text: This is an example of a fit test.
segments.zh: 这是一个适合性检验的例子。

segments.text: Now a fit test is a requirement when you select a respirator for your particular facial
segments.zh: 当你为自己特定的脸型或面部轮廓选择呼吸器时，

segments.text: type or your face profile.
segments.zh: 适合性检验是一项必要要求。

segments.text: Now the lady in this picture is wearing a respirator which has been designed for her
segments.zh: 图中这位女士佩戴的是一个专为她的

segments.text: facial profile.
segments.zh: 面部轮廓设计的呼吸器。

segments.text: Now before she actually comments his work in the lab, this respirator must be fit tested
segments.zh: 在她真正开始在实验室工作之前，这个呼吸器必须进行适合性检验，

segments.text: and this fit testing is achieved by wearing this specific gear over the face and the biosafety
segments.zh: 适合性检验的方法是在面部戴上这种特定装置，然后生物安全

segments.text: officer which is this gentleman is using a nebulizer to create an aerosol in this particular space.
segments.zh: 官员，也就是这位先生，用雾化器在这个空间内制造气溶胶。

segments.text: Now this nebulizer may contain an agent which has a particular order and a particular taste
segments.zh: 这个雾化器里可能装有一种具有特殊气味和特殊味道的物质，

segments.text: and if the mask is effective, this user should not be able to detect the order or the taste
segments.zh: 如果口罩有效，使用者应该察觉不到

segments.text: of this particular aerosol and fit testing is an essential procedure which must be conducted
segments.zh: 这种气溶胶的气味或味道，适合性检验是一项基本程序，必须在

segments.text: prior to selecting a mask to suit your particular facial profile.
segments.zh: 选择适合你特定面部轮廓的口罩之前进行。

segments.text: Gloves are available in many forms.
segments.zh: 手套有多种形式。

segments.text: We have the latex gloves, nitrile gloves as well as reinforced gloves.
segments.zh: 有乳胶手套、丁腈手套以及加固手套。

segments.text: Now latex gloves are not recommended for usage with chemicals as they are permeable to many
segments.zh: 乳胶手套不建议在接触化学品时使用，因为许多

segments.text: of the organic solvents.
segments.zh: 有机溶剂可以渗透乳胶手套。

segments.text: Nitrile gloves on the other hand are impermeable to solvents but must be used in accordance
segments.zh: 而丁腈手套不透溶剂，但必须在其

segments.text: with their limitations.
segments.zh: 局限范围内使用。

segments.text: Nitrile gloving is another procedure which is recommended for operations involving biological
segments.zh: 戴双层手套是另一种推荐用于涉及生物

segments.text: agents.
segments.zh: 因子操作的做法。

segments.text: This is to mitigate any effect from spills.
segments.zh: 这是为了减轻溢洒造成的任何影响。

segments.text: Reinforced gloves are recommended when working with animals such as mice in the laboratory
segments.zh: 在实验室环境中操作小鼠等动物时，建议使用加固手套，

segments.text: setting as animals tend to scratch and cause injuries to the skin.
segments.zh: 因为动物往往会抓挠，造成皮肤损伤。

segments.text: Protective suits are designed to protect the user from exposure to biological agents.
segments.zh: 防护服的设计目的是保护使用者免于接触生物因子。

segments.text: They can be worn both in the laboratory and in the field.
segments.zh: 它们既可以在实验室中穿着，也可以在现场穿着。

segments.text: They will protect you against minor splashes but cannot be used to mitigate major spills.
segments.zh: 它们可以防护轻微的喷溅，但不能用来应对大量溢洒。

segments.text: They involve a high cost and they are one-time use which means that they cannot be recycled
segments.zh: 它们成本很高，而且是一次性使用的，也就是说使用后

segments.text: after usage.
segments.zh: 不能回收再用。

segments.text: Protective eyewear such as shields which are face shields are designed to protect the
segments.zh: 防护眼具，例如面罩，其设计目的是防止

segments.text: entry of the biological agent via the ocular route.
segments.zh: 生物因子经眼部途径进入。

segments.text: They will protect you against minor splashes however if you are working with aerosols it
segments.zh: 它们可以防护轻微的喷溅，但如果你操作的是气溶胶，

segments.text: is recommended that you use a powered air purifying respirator and not a face shield.
segments.zh: 建议使用电动送风过滤式呼吸器，而不是面罩。

segments.text: Powered air purifying respirators are designed to protect the laboratory user from aerosols
segments.zh: 电动送风过滤式呼吸器的设计目的是保护实验室使用者免受

segments.text: that can be generated in the laboratory.
segments.zh: 实验室中可能产生的气溶胶的危害。

segments.text: Let us look at the basic setup.
segments.zh: 让我们来看看基本构造。

segments.text: In this case the upper portion of this respirator comprises the helmet and if you
segments.zh: 这种呼吸器的上部是头盔，如果你

segments.text: look through the helmet which is transparent you will see the filter.
segments.zh: 透过透明的头盔看，就会看到过滤器。

segments.text: This is the N95 filter.
segments.zh: 这是N95过滤器。

segments.text: The air is directed over this filter through it and into this space over the user's face.
segments.zh: 空气被引导经过并穿过这个过滤器，进入使用者面部前方的这个空间。

segments.text: Now the air flow generates a positive pressure in this region and the air exits through
segments.zh: 气流在这个区域形成正压，空气从

segments.text: this apron and this creates a curtain of air around the user.
segments.zh: 这个围裙处排出，在使用者周围形成一道空气幕。

segments.text: Now this curtain of air prevents the ingestion of aerosols via this particular route.
segments.zh: 这道空气幕可以防止气溶胶经这一途径被吸入。

segments.text: So there is always a positive pressure of air which keeps the pathogens or the biological
segments.zh: 所以始终存在正压气流，使病原体或生物

segments.text: agents out of the user's facial area.
segments.zh: 因子远离使用者的面部区域。

segments.text: And this kind of powered air purifying respirator can protect you against aerosols as well
segments.zh: 这种电动送风过滤式呼吸器在日常实验室操作中，既能防护气溶胶，

segments.text: as splashes during routine laboratory operations.
segments.zh: 也能防护喷溅。

segments.text: A video on the usage of the respirator can be accessed from this particular link.
segments.zh: 关于这种呼吸器使用方法的视频可以通过这个链接观看。

segments.text: I have prepared a link for you with a tutorial on the usage of the PAPR.
segments.zh: 我为大家准备了一个链接，里面有PAPR使用教程。

segments.text: Pressurized suits are generally used in a BSL4 laboratory and this pressurized suit
segments.zh: 正压防护服一般用于BSL4实验室，这种正压防护服

segments.text: is supplied with pressurized A via a tube.
segments.zh: 通过一根管子供应加压空气。

segments.text: The suit is maintained as a positive pressure environment.
segments.zh: 防护服内保持正压环境。

segments.text: In the case of a breach of containment, for instance a tear in the suit or a needle stick
segments.zh: 如果发生防护失效，例如防护服撕裂或针刺

segments.text: injury, the air will basically exit through the suit and prevent the intake of any kind
segments.zh: 伤，空气基本上会从防护服中向外排出，防止吸入任何

segments.text: of biological agent.
segments.zh: 生物因子。

segments.text: Pressurized suits are extremely expensive and their usage is limited to BSL4 and other
segments.zh: 正压防护服极其昂贵，其使用仅限于BSL4及其他

segments.text: high containment facilities.
segments.zh: 高等级防护设施。

segments.text: We now move on to the selection of the PPEs.
segments.zh: 现在我们来讲个人防护装备的选择。

segments.text: The PPEs is based on the risk assessment.
segments.zh: 个人防护装备的选择以风险评估为基础。

segments.text: Now in the risk assessment we must consider the biological agent itself and the risk group
segments.zh: 在风险评估中，我们必须考虑生物因子本身及其所属的

segments.text: to which it belongs.
segments.zh: 危险度等级。

segments.text: Now I have indicated another risk group here which is novel.
segments.zh: 我在这里还列出了另一个危险度等级，即新型。

segments.text: So in case the risk group is unknown or novel, we must utilize the highest level of protection
segments.zh: 如果危险度等级未知或属于新型，我们必须采用最高级别的防护，

segments.text: which involves the pressurized suit.
segments.zh: 也就是正压防护服。

segments.text: The various risk groups and their PPEs associated with them are listed in this particular table.
segments.zh: 各个危险度等级及其相应的个人防护装备都列在这张表中。

segments.text: So we have respirators for risk group 1 and 2.
segments.zh: 对于危险度等级1和2，我们使用呼吸器。

segments.text: However, in the case of the higher risk groups, it is recommended that a biosafety suit and
segments.zh: 但对于较高的危险度等级，建议将生物安全防护服和

segments.text: a PAPR be utilized in conjunction with each other.
segments.zh: PAPR配合使用。

segments.text: We must also take into account the portal of entry when selecting the PPE.
segments.zh: 选择个人防护装备时，我们还必须考虑侵入门户。

segments.text: So in this case, we must select the PPE based on the route of entry or the portal of entry
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，我们必须根据生物因子的进入途径或侵入门户

segments.text: of the biological agent.
segments.zh: 来选择个人防护装备。

segments.text: I have given you this table and you can study it in order to determine the selection
segments.zh: 我给大家提供了这张表，你们可以研究它，以确定如何

segments.text: of the PPE based on the portal of entry.
segments.zh: 根据侵入门户选择个人防护装备。

segments.text: PPEs must also take into account laboratory procedures.
segments.zh: 个人防护装备还必须考虑实验室操作程序。

segments.text: For instance, a simple laboratory procedure such as receiving a sample may require donning
segments.zh: 例如，像接收样本这样简单的实验室操作，可能需要穿上

segments.text: or wearing of gloves, a respirator, and a biosafety suit.
segments.zh: 或戴上手套、呼吸器和生物安全防护服。

segments.text: However, when you process the sample using PPEs which can generate an aerosol, we must
segments.zh: 但是，当你在使用个人防护装备的情况下以可能产生气溶胶的方式处理样本时，我们必须

segments.text: use additional protection such as a PAPR.
segments.zh: 使用额外的防护，比如PAPR。

segments.text: Certain procedures such as nucleic acid extraction or DNA and RNA extraction may
segments.zh: 某些操作，例如核酸提取或DNA和RNA提取，可能

segments.text: also require usage of PAPR as the process of centrifugation and extraction can lead
segments.zh: 也需要使用PAPR，因为离心和提取过程可能导致

segments.text: to the production of aerosols.
segments.zh: 气溶胶的产生。

segments.text: Another challenge faced by laboratory workers is working with animals.
segments.zh: 实验室工作人员面临的另一个挑战是操作动物。

segments.text: Small animals tend to bite and scratch and this can lead to cutaneous wounds and biological
segments.zh: 小动物往往会咬人和抓人，这可能导致皮肤伤口，生物

segments.text: agents can enter through these cuts and scratches in the skin.
segments.zh: 因子可以通过皮肤上的这些伤口和抓痕进入人体。

segments.text: When we conduct a risk assessment for animals, we must look at these factors, the size of
segments.zh: 当我们对动物进行风险评估时，必须考察这些因素：

segments.text: the animal, the behavior of the animal, the reservoir for potential human pathogens, ozonotic
segments.zh: 动物的体型、动物的行为、是否为潜在人类病原体的储存宿主、人兽共患病

segments.text: agents, the field work or laboratory work, and the portal of entry of the biological
segments.zh: 病原体、是现场工作还是实验室工作，以及动物携带的生物

segments.text: agent carried by the animals.
segments.zh: 因子的侵入门户。

segments.text: Working with large animals may involve the selection and usage of specific PPEs.
segments.zh: 操作大型动物可能需要选择和使用特定的个人防护装备。

segments.text: PPEs must be used in conjunction with administrative controls.
segments.zh: 个人防护装备必须与管理控制配合使用。

segments.text: The selection of PPEs must be done after thorough risk assessment.
segments.zh: 个人防护装备的选择必须在全面的风险评估之后进行。

segments.text: This in itself is an administrative control.
segments.zh: 这本身就是一种管理控制。

segments.text: The choice of PPEs depends on the risk group and the laboratory procedure which is another
segments.zh: 个人防护装备的选择取决于危险度等级和实验室操作程序，这是另一种

segments.text: administrative control.
segments.zh: 管理控制。

segments.text: Laboratory users must be trained to don and doff PPEs in compliance with SOPs.
segments.zh: 实验室使用者必须经过培训，按照标准操作程序穿脱个人防护装备。

segments.text: Doffing refers to wearing of a PPE and doffing refers to removal of a PPE.
segments.zh: 穿戴指的是穿上个人防护装备，脱卸指的是脱下个人防护装备。

segments.text: All incidents and accidents involving PPEs must be documented and reported during the audit.
segments.zh: 所有涉及个人防护装备的事件和事故都必须记录下来，并在审核时报告。

segments.text: This includes tearing of the PPE during usage as well as the expiry date.
segments.zh: 这包括使用过程中个人防护装备的撕裂以及过期日期。

segments.text: Now, PPEs have an expiry date and a PPE should not be used after the expiry date.
segments.zh: 个人防护装备有有效期，过了有效期就不应再使用。

segments.text: PPEs must be disposed in accordance with standard operating procedures for waste handling.
segments.zh: 个人防护装备必须按照废物处理的标准操作程序进行处置。

segments.text: This may involve the usage of autoclaves as well as incineration.
segments.zh: 这可能涉及使用高压灭菌器以及焚烧。

segments.text: To summarize, the selection of PPEs is based on risk assessment.
segments.zh: 总结一下，个人防护装备的选择以风险评估为基础。

segments.text: We first look at the risk group.
segments.zh: 我们首先看危险度等级。

segments.text: The next aspect which we look at is the portal of entry.
segments.zh: 接下来看的是侵入门户。

segments.text: And finally, we look at the laboratory procedures.
segments.zh: 最后，我们看实验室操作程序。

segments.text: Please note that all PPEs must be utilized in accordance with the standard operating procedures.
